verdicts.reason: A gets the hierarchy backwards: the OBSIDIAN logo is blown up into the hero, while the headline 'Silence, engineered' shrinks to small text in the bottom-left corner and the Shop button floats off-axis with no right margin to anchor it, leaving large dead areas with no shared grid. B is just the original strip scaled up and centred in the 16:9 canvas, so the top and bottom thirds are empty and the Shop pill sits tight to the right edge, but the headline and CTA stay prominent and the brand reads correctly, which makes it the less bad of the two.
